k1.author: seed
k1.text: Call svc.apply(app) with the application dict; it returns a dict.

k2.author: seed
k2.text: In API v1 the response has `decision` (approve or decline) and `limit` (integer).

k3.author: curator-C
k3.quote: approve: issue the card with the returned limit. decline: decline the application. refer: the application is not decided; place it in the manual review queue (action queue_review) and do not decline it.
k3.text: handle(app, svc) returns {action, limit}. If svc.apply decision is "approve" -> action "issue" with the returned limit; "decline" -> action "decline" with limit 0; "refer" -> action "queue_review" with limit 0 (do not decline).

k4.author: curator-C
k4.quote: For every partner in the network, whatever the partner decided, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 6000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k4.text: Network referral rule: for any partner, an application from a self_employed applicant with requested_limit above 6000 must be placed in manual review (action queue_review) instead of being issued, regardless of the partner's decision. A decline stays a decline (action decline, limit 0).

k5.author: curator-C
k5.quote: svc.apply returns a dict with `decision` ("approve", "decline" or "refer") and `limit` (an integer, 0 unless approved).
k5.text: svc.apply(app) returns a dict with `decision` ("approve", "decline" or "refer") and `limit` (an integer, 0 unless approved).
